title: Портной, свидание и Пригожин  (The Tailor, the Date, and Prigozhin)

segments.t: Instead of dieting, Chef Barinov secretly visits a tailor to have his tight suit let out. Meanwhile, Ainura tells Lyova that Gulya agreed to a date in a week, and Max—chasing the locker-room thief into traffic—gets bumped by producer Iosif Prigozhin's car.

Спасибо, Соломон Иванович. Теперь всё можно!
Хорошая новость. Гуля согласна.
Но есть и плохая.
Тебе придётся ждать целую неделю.
Только она просила никому не говорить.
Айнура очень строгая, может запретить.
Вы на Иосифа Пригожина похожи.
К сожалению, я он и есть.
Меня сбил Иосиф Пригожин!
Если можно, пусть это останется между нами.
Чёрт, Вика!

'Thank you, Solomon Ivanovich. Now everything is allowed!' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'thank you', while 'may' completes the thought.

'Good news. Gulya agrees.' The grammar packs 'good' and 'agreeable' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.

'But there is also bad news.' The meaning hinges on 'but' working together with 'bad' in spoken Russian.

'You will have to wait a whole week.' Notice how Russian expresses 'to you' and 'week' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.

'Only she asked not to tell anyone.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'only' before landing on 'to speak'.

'Ainura is very strict, she might forbid it.' Notice how Russian expresses 'Ainura' and 'to forbid' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Max answers right away.

'You look like Iosif Prigozhin.' Max brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'on' in a few short words.

'Unfortunately, I am him.' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'regret' and 'I' in a few short words.
Меня сбил Иосиф Пригожин!
'Iosif Prigozhin hit me!' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'me' before landing on 'Prigozhin'. Chef Barinov answers right away.
Если можно, пусть это останется между нами.
'If possible, let this stay between us.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'if', while 'us' completes the thought.
Чёрт, Вика!
